title: The Most Valuable AI Skill Isn't Prompting
description: In a factory, the scarce skill is not prompting. It is noticing what is wrong before the system compounds it.
style: 1950s space western industrial noir, dark chocolate software factory, frontier astronomy, brass machinery, amber practical light, restrained cyan signal lights, cinematic but readable editorial illustration

placements.altText: The Most Valuable AI Skill Isn't Prompting: What a Factory Changes
placements.captionSeed: a watchtower observer spotting repeated patterns across factory rails before the crew notices
placements.sectionExcerpt: When you move from prompting to factory, the bottleneck shifts. In the pair-programming model, the human is everything: the prompter, the reviewer, the judge. Prompting skill matters because the human is in every loop. In a factory, the human is the director.

placements.altText: The Most Valuable AI Skill Isn't Prompting: What Noticing Actually Is
placements.captionSeed: a prompt scroll being replaced by steel rails and reusable machine jigs
placements.sectionExcerpt: Noticing isn't just code review. It's a higher-order pattern-matching skill: You see an architectural decision in PR 47 that's technically correct but will create a coupling problem in six months. You see a test suite that passes but is testing the wrong thing
